monetization.noteEs: Free-to-play completo: todo el contenido jugable (warframes, armas, misiones) se consigue jugando. La moneda premium (Platinum) se compra con dinero real pero también se obtiene comerciando con otros jugadores, así que un jugador activo puede acceder a cosméticos y slots sin gastar. Lo único exclusivamente pago es la conveniencia (boosters, slots extra) y el acceso anticipado a Prime gear vía Prime Access. No hay power buyable que no se pueda farmear.
monetization.noteEn: Fully free-to-play: all playable content (warframes, weapons, missions) is earned in-game. The premium currency (Platinum) is bought with real money but also earned by trading with other players, so an active player can access cosmetics and slots without spending. The only strictly paid things are convenience (boosters, extra slots) and early access to Prime gear via Prime Access. No buyable power that can't be farmed.
